速服解药，过此巳午日则止疼矣。
即服解药，至申日，其病如常。
yi: 断语：这个医生不能用。
虽然是子孙持世，应爻是医生，但初爻巳火发动克申金不合适，又有卯木生火，世爻虽然旺，巳日一定添灾。
他不听，还是请这位医生来治。
卯日、辰日服药，还平安，巳日忽然病症变了，全身疼痛难以忍受。
病人着急，问我说：会伤到性命吗？
我说：世爻值月建，怎么会伤命？
赶快服解药，过了巳日、午日就不疼了。
立即服了解药，到申日，他的病像平常一样。
en: Judgment: this doctor must not be used.

Though Output holds the Self line and the Other line is the doctor, it is not fitting that the first line, Si Fire, moves and controls Shen Metal, with Mao Wood also generating Fire; though the Self line is strong, on the Si day there will surely be added trouble.
He did not listen and called this doctor to treat him.
On the Mao and Chen days he took the medicine and was still safe, but on the Si day the symptoms suddenly changed and pain all over the body was unbearable.
The patient was anxious and asked me: will it endanger my life?
I said: the Self line rules the Month; how could it endanger life?
Take the antidote quickly, and once the Si and Wu days are past the pain will stop.
He took the antidote at once, and by the Shen day his illness was as usual.

note.yi: 这一条是对 LY.ILL.ZS.10（子孙持世不药而痊）的补充限制：子孙持世还要看它有没有被克。书中例是占医生，不是占病：子孙持世、应是医人，但初爻巳火动来克申金，野鹤据此断这位医生的药会在巳日添灾。
note.en: This entry is a limiting supplement to LY.ILL.ZS.10 (Output holding the Self line heals without medicine): one must also see whether Output is controlled. The case divines a doctor and not an illness: Output holds the Self line and the Other line is the doctor, but the Si Fire at the first line moves to control Shen Metal, and from this the Old Man judged that this doctor's medicine would bring added trouble on the Si day.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on a doctor divining whether to go and treat
units.title: 来人所问决定看什么：问病的吉凶，鬼持世或动是忧神、子孙持世或动是解忧喜悦之神；问病犯何鬼神，看鬼爻五行（金鬼冲犯武神、水鬼得罪河神）；问病源，看鬼爻五行脏腑（火鬼心经、水鬼肾部）——李我平

rule.yi: 官鬼是忧神、子孙是喜悦解忧之神，虽然是古法，用起来很恰当；但也有不把鬼当忧神的，全看来问的人心里想问什么。他问病的吉凶：鬼爻持世、鬼在卦里发动，是忧神；子孙持世、子孙发动，是解忧喜悦的神。他问病是犯了哪路鬼神：卦里出现金鬼，一定冲犯了武神；水鬼，一定得罪了河神这一类。他问病源：卦里出现火鬼，一定属心经；水鬼，一定在肾部。
rule.en: That the Pressure line is the spirit of worry and Output the spirit of joy that relieves worry, though an old method, is very apt in use; but there are cases in which Pressure is not taken as the spirit of worry, and it all depends on what the asker has in mind to ask. If he asks about the fortune of the illness: Pressure holding the Self line or moving in the hexagram is the spirit of worry, and Output holding the Self line or moving is the spirit of joy that relieves worry. If he asks which ghost or spirit the illness offends: a Metal Pressure appearing in the hexagram means he has surely offended a martial god, and a Water Pressure that he has offended the river god and the like. If he asks about the source of the illness: a Fire Pressure appearing in the hexagram surely belongs to the Heart channel, and a Water Pressure surely lies in the Kidney.

zh: 李我平曰：此论官鬼为忧神，子孙为喜悦解忧之神，虽系古法，然用之甚当，非合鬼神之机，不能幻想至此。
然又有不以鬼作忧神者，全在来人念之所指。
yi: 李我平说：这个论断把官鬼当作忧神，把子孙当作喜悦解忧的神，虽然是古法，用起来却很恰当，不是合了鬼神的机要，想不到这一步。
但是也有不把鬼当忧神的，全在来问的人心里念头指向什么。
en: Li Woping says: this account takes the Pressure line as the spirit of worry and Output as the spirit of joy that relieves worry; though it is an old method, it is very apt in use, and one could not have imagined it without accord with the working of the spirits.
But there are cases in which Pressure is not taken as the spirit of worry, and it all depends on what the asker has in mind.

zh: 彼若问病之凶吉，倘鬼爻持世、鬼动卦中，则为忧神；
子持世、子动卦中，则为解忧喜悦之神。
彼若问病犯是何鬼神，倘卦现金鬼，必冲犯于武神；
水鬼，必获罪于河神之类。
彼若问病源，卦现火鬼，必属心经；
水鬼，必居肾部。
yi: 他如果问病的吉凶，假使鬼爻持世、鬼在卦中发动，那就是忧神；
子孙持世、子孙在卦中发动，就是解忧喜悦的神。
他如果问病是犯了哪路鬼神，假使卦里出现金鬼，一定是冲犯了武神；
水鬼，一定是得罪了河神这一类。
他如果问病源，卦里出现火鬼，一定属心经；
水鬼，一定在肾这一部。
en: If he asks about the fortune of the illness, then if the Pressure line holds the Self line or moves in the hexagram, it is the spirit of worry;
if Output holds the Self line or moves in the hexagram, it is the spirit of joy that relieves worry.
If he asks which ghost or spirit the illness offends, then if a Metal Pressure appears in the hexagram, he has surely offended a martial god;
a Water Pressure means he has surely offended the river god and the like.
If he asks about the source of the illness, then if a Fire Pressure appears in the hexagram it surely belongs to the Heart channel;
a Water Pressure surely lies in the Kidney.

note.yi: 李我平在这里把三种看法各归到它回答的问题上：野鹤的「忧神/喜悦神」回答病的吉凶，觉子的五行鬼神（LY.ILL.ZS.23）回答犯了什么，黄金策疾病章开头的五行脏腑（LY.ILL.HJC.02）回答病在哪里。所以野鹤删掉黄金策的首论（LY.ILL.ZS.22），李我平认为不是不对，是问题不同。
note.en: Here Li Woping assigns each of three ways of looking to the question it answers: the Old Man's 'spirit of worry and spirit of joy' answers the fortune of the illness, Juezi's ghosts and spirits by phase (LY.ILL.ZS.23) answers what has been offended, and the organs by phase at the opening of the Huangjin Ce's chapter on illness (LY.ILL.HJC.02) answers where the illness lies. So when the Old Man deletes the opening discussion of the Huangjin Ce (LY.ILL.ZS.22), Li Woping holds that it is not wrong but answers a different question.

units.chapter_en: Chapter on a doctor divining whether to go and treat
units.title: 子孙不是针灸之药，火鬼忌热水鬼忌寒是拘泥：子孙旺动则不药自愈，前贤以金生子孙用针、火持子孙用炙是错；诸书说火鬼旺宜大寒药、水鬼旺宜大热药，李我平举土用神、妻占夫二例驳之，说胶柱决之坑陷人命

rule.yi: 子孙旺相又发动的，不吃药就好，并不是教人拿这个子孙当治病的药；前辈贤人常常看到子孙旺动，占病病好、占医医良，就把子孙爻当成治病的药，金生子孙就断用针，火持子孙就断用灸，不知道子孙旺相病自己就好了，哪里用得着针灸，子孙落空被破，针灸又有什么益处。各种书又说火鬼忌热、水鬼忌寒，水鬼在生旺之地要用大热的药，火鬼旺相宜用大寒的药去攻；李我平不知道他们从哪里看出来的：假使用神属土、儿子占父亲的病，父爻临土，火鬼发动是生用爻的元神，怎么能用大寒的药去治元神？妻子占丈夫的病，鬼是用神，丈夫临水鬼，又怎么能用大热的药去攻用神？死板地照大寒大热去断，坑害了不知多少性命。
rule.en: Where Output is strong and moving, one recovers without medicine, and this does not teach us to take that Output as the medicine that treats the illness; the worthies of old often saw Output strong and moving, found that in divining illness the illness healed and in divining a doctor the doctor was good, and so took the Output line as the medicine, judging the needle where Metal generates Output and moxibustion where Fire holds Output, without realising that if Output is strong the illness heals of itself, so what need is there of needle and moxa, and if Output is Void or broken what good would they do. The books also say that a Fire Pressure fears heat and a Water Pressure fears cold, that a Water Pressure in a place of birth or strength must be treated with very hot medicine and a strong Fire Pressure attacked with very cold; Li Woping does not know where they saw this: suppose the Subject is Earth, as when a son divines his father's illness and the Resource line sits on Earth, a moving Fire Pressure is the Support that generates the Subject line, and how could one treat the Support with very cold medicine? When a wife divines her husband's illness, Pressure is the Subject, and if the husband sits on a Water Pressure, how could one attack the Subject with very hot medicine? To judge rigidly by very cold and very hot has sunk who knows how many lives in the pit.

zh: 子孙旺而动者，不药而愈，非教人以此子孙为治病之药也，往往前贤见此子孙旺动，占病病愈，占医医良，遂以此子孙爻为治病之药。
金生子孙者，断用针；
火持子孙者，断用炙。
殊不知子孙若旺，其病自痊，何用针灸？
子孙若值空破，用针灸而何益？
yi: 子孙旺相又发动的，不吃药就好，并不是教人拿这个子孙当治病的药；往往前辈贤人看到这个子孙旺相发动，占病病好，占医医生高明，就拿这个子孙爻当成治病的药了。
金生子孙的，就断用针；
火持子孙的，就断用灸。
殊不知子孙如果旺相，那病自己就好了，哪里用得着针灸？
子孙如果落空、被破，用针灸又有什么益处？
en: Where Output is strong and moving, one recovers without medicine, and this does not teach us to take that Output as the medicine that treats the illness; the worthies of old often saw Output strong and moving, found that in divining illness the illness healed and in divining a doctor the doctor was good, and so took that Output line as the medicine that treats the illness.
Where Metal generates Output, they judged to use the needle;
where Fire holds Output, to use moxibustion.
They did not realise that if Output is strong the illness heals of itself, so what need is there of needle and moxa?
and if Output is Void or broken, what good would needle and moxa do?

zh: 诸书又皆曰：“火鬼忌热，水鬼忌寒，水鬼若居生旺之地，须大热之药以治之；
火鬼旺者，宜大寒之剂以攻之。”
余不知从何所见。
假使用神属土，及子占父病，父爻临土，若得火鬼发动，乃生用爻之元神也，岂可用大寒之药而治元神耶？
又如妻占夫病，鬼为用神，假便夫临水鬼，又可以大热之药以攻夫爻之用神耶？
每见穷乡僻壤，无处觅医，只谓《周易》乃大圣大贤之书，遵之必灵，而卜者以此大寒大热之药胶柱决之，不知坑陷如许之命，言及发指。
此书一出，而寒热之药不敢轻用，从此泉下无怨鬼矣。
yi: 各种书又都说：“火鬼忌热，水鬼忌寒，水鬼如果在生旺的地方，要用大热的药来治；
火鬼旺相的，宜用大寒的药去攻它。”
我不知道他们是从哪里看出来的。
假使用神属土，比如儿子占父亲的病，父爻临土，如果火鬼发动，那是生用爻的元神，怎么可以用大寒的药去治元神呢？
又如妻子占丈夫的病，鬼是用神，假使丈夫临水鬼，又可以用大热的药去攻丈夫爻的用神吗？
常见穷乡僻壤，没有地方找医生，只当《周易》是大圣大贤的书，照着它办必定灵验，而占卜的人拿这大寒大热的药死板地去决断，不知道坑害了多少条命，说起来令人发指。
这部书一出来，寒热的药就不敢轻易用了，从此黄泉之下没有含冤的鬼了。
en: The books all say again: 'A Fire Pressure fears heat and a Water Pressure fears cold; if a Water Pressure is in a place of birth or strength, it must be treated with very hot medicine;
if a Fire Pressure is strong, attack it with very cold medicine.'
I do not know from where they saw this.

Suppose the Subject is Earth, as when a son divines his father's illness and the Resource line sits on Earth; if a Fire Pressure moves, it is the Support that generates the Subject line, and how could one treat the Support with very cold medicine?
Again, when a wife divines her husband's illness, Pressure is the Subject; suppose the husband sits on a Water Pressure, may one attack the husband line's Subject with very hot medicine?

I have often seen in poor and remote places where there is nowhere to find a doctor, people who think the Zhouyi a book of great sages and worthies that must prove true if followed, and diviners who settle the matter rigidly with these very cold and very hot medicines, not knowing how many lives they have sunk into the pit; it makes one's hair stand on end to speak of it.
Once this book is out, no one will dare to use cold or hot medicines lightly, and from then on there will be no wronged ghosts under the springs.

dispute.yi: 用药看什么：黄金策旧注、王洪绪（LY.ILL.HJC.76、HJC.81、HJC.84）按官鬼的五行定寒热（火鬼旺用大寒、水鬼旺用大热），按子孙的五行定针灸（子孙属金用刀针、属火用灸）；李我平、野鹤说这是拘泥：子孙旺动本来就不药而愈，不是针灸之药；火鬼可能是用神的元神，不能拿大寒药去攻；死板照大寒大热去断，是坑人性命。
dispute.en: What to look at in fixing the medicine: the old commentary of the Huangjin Ce and Wang Hongxu (LY.ILL.HJC.76, HJC.81, HJC.84) fix cold or hot by the phase of the Pressure line (a strong Fire Pressure very cold, a strong Water Pressure very hot) and needle or moxa by the phase of Output (Metal Output knife and needle, Fire Output moxa); Li Woping and the Old Man call this rigid: Output strong and moving means recovery without medicine and is not the medicine of needle and moxa, a Fire Pressure may be the Support of the Subject and cannot be attacked with very cold medicine, and to judge rigidly by very cold and very hot sinks lives.

note.yi: 这是整个疾病域里两派分歧最尖锐的一条。李我平末尾说「此书一出，而寒热之药不敢轻用」，是说《增删卜易》出来以后，占卜的人不该再拿五行定寒热。「炙」「灸」在书里写法不一，都指艾灸。「元神」的用法见 LY.ILL.ZS.08。
note.en: This is the sharpest split between the two schools in the whole illness domain. Li Woping's closing 'once this book is out, no one will dare to use cold or hot medicines lightly' means that after the Zengshan Buyi diviners should no longer fix cold and hot by the five phases. 'Zhi' and 'jiu' are written differently in the book and both mean moxibustion. For the use of the 'Support' see LY.ILL.ZS.08. The 'Qian note' at the end of the chapter is a modern addition and is not quoted here.
